description: Accepts a hello the person has received, which opens a conversation with the person who sent it. Needs a personal connector token and the hello as `firstName` (as an event_requests row spelled it) or `requestId` (as that row gave it). It accepts only hellos addressed to the caller; the server checks this and refuses with NOT_RECEIVER otherwise. A `firstName` that matches two waiting hellos returns AMBIGUOUS_NAME and accepts nothing. Accepting twice changes nothing. Returns ok:true when the conversation is open; event_inbox reads it and event_reply answers in it.

firstName.description: Optional. The first name as an event_requests row spelled it, matched against the caller's own pending hellos only. Two matches return AMBIGUOUS_NAME and nothing is accepted.

requestId.description: Optional. The requestId as an event_requests row gave it. When both this and firstName are sent, this one is used.

name: event_accept
title: Accept a hello
